messages.content: I never received the Tiffany necklace. Tracking says it was signed for by someone at my building but it wasn't me and it never reached my apartment.
The tracking shows it was delivered and signed for by building staff. That means it was received at your address. You may want to follow up with your building management.

I already spoke with management. They have no record of receiving it for my unit. The package room is not secure — anyone in the building can walk in. A signature from building staff doesn't mean I personally received it.

I'm sorry about the situation but the carrier confirmed delivery with a signature. I shipped the item and it was received at your building. This seems like a building management issue rather than a seller issue.
